title: EU commissioner vows to use ‘all relevant tools’ to protect media freedom as Babiš public broadcasting bill alarms MEPs
lede: MEPs spoke out against the Czech government's controversial broadcasting overhaul, while commissioner Michael McGrath said he would use “all relevant tools” to protect media freedom. Czechs in Brussels gathered outside parliament to protest.

title: Push for ocean roadmap that informs next global stocktake grows at COP31
lede: A group of countries including African nations, European Union, and small island states wants COP31 to deliver an ocean roadmap towards 2028 The post Push for ocean roadmap that informs next global stocktake grows at COP31 appeared first on Climate Home News .

title: Canadian companies ‘haven’t lost the plot on climate’ despite net zero retreat
lede: Climate Engagement Canada's fourth benchmark finds corporate progress on capex and scenario analysis, even as longer term commitments soften.

title: G20 sustainable finance rules grow but enforcement hits ‘real-world stress-testing’
lede: Taskforce on Net Zero Policy's 2026 report finds rising ambition but flatlined stringency as sustainable finance policy instruments 'mature'.

title: Fastest EU citizens’ initiative ever pushes Brussels to end EU‑Israel trade agreement
lede: Over one million Europeans back the ending of the EU-Israel trade agreement, in the latest citizen effort to hold European governments to account for their human rights commitments. Now the EU Commission has up to six months to respond.
